about_the_game:
The Name

Zona Pugna Exitium, or Zugnaex for short, is Latin for the Battle Zone of Doom. Also known as Doom Battle Zone.

It's the classic DOOM® game with a different multiplayer experience. Players battle across zones in DOOM®.

The Story

Zugnaex is a very powerful demon. If you say its name correctly, every single little tiny syllable, you will summon the demon and bring forth the apocalypse. But Zugnaex has never faced a foe like you. Only you & your friends can defeat the demon Zugnaex & save humanity!

Battle online with your friends and overcome different challenges to ultimately face the demon itself.

The Code

Some of it was written by me. Most of it was written by you. You can use all of it to make something amazing yourself!

Build Battles!

Use the included source code to build your own battles.

zugzug.zip - This is the source code for zugnaex and zugsrv. See the README file for instructions on how to build. (License: GPLv2)

zugbat.zip - This is the source code for an example battle, "Kneed Time." Try to finish a random UV E1 map in par. See the README file for instructions on how to setup and run the battle. (License: MIT)

Important! Please read before you purchase

You are purchasing an unofficial DOOM® client. It's a modification of the 1993 DOOM® source code with a supporting online service that provides a unique multiplayer experience. You also get the source code for an extensible framework that lets you create multiplayer multiserver battles. This game comes with no playable content. To play or battle, you must own DOOM® and DOOM II®. Alternatively, for single player only, you can download free compatible WADS (game data files) online like Freedoom(1) and DOOM® Shareware(1).

1) These are independent projects (see below for details).
